issues.quote: Net income grew 144.9% to $72.9 billion in fiscal 2025 from $31.7 billion in fiscal 2024
issues.problem: NVIDIA's fiscal 2024 net income was about $29.8 billion ($29,760M), not $31.7 billion. The 144.9% growth rate only works with $29.8 billion; from $31.7 billion, growth would be about 130%.

data.summary: Revenue, gross profit, margins, operating income, EPS and R&D figures match NVIDIA's reported results. The one error is fiscal 2024 net income: it was about $29.8 billion, not $31.7 billion, and that figure doesn't fit the 144.9% growth rate the analysis quotes.
